mapper.sql: p.id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.cover_file_id, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.name AS category_name, f.bucket AS cover_bucket, f.object_key AS cover_object_key
FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN file_object f ON f.id = p.cover_file_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (category_id, name, description, price, cover_file_id, status) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{coverFileId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, cover_file_id = #{coverFileId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.status = 'ON_SALE'
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
